title: Manager notification not reaching chat -5268718508
description: When a customer places an order, the bot creates it successfully (customer gets confirmation) but the manager at chat ID -5268718508 does not receive the notification. title: Fix spec audit findings (12 issues)
description:
Address all 12 issues from SPEC_AUDIT.md:

HIGH:
1. PATCH /orders/:id/status does not insert into status_transitions (FR-010/SC-005 violation)
2. PATCH /orders/:id/status does not call Telegram sendMessage; notification_sent hardcoded false (FR-008 violation)
3. validateCredentials falls back to 'changeme' when DASHBOARD_PASSWORD unset

MEDIUM:
4. Dead/broken workers/dashboard-api/{lib,handlers}/*.ts files reference non-existent schema (order_status_transitions, customers.name)
5. Dead bot implementations in src/handlers/{customer,manager}.ts use grammY; only raw-fetch src/index.ts is deployed

LOW:
6. /list output format deviates from contracts/bot-api.md
7. Status transitions strictly enforced; data-model says skipping is allowed
8. GET /customers uses ?id= query param instead of /customers/:id path per contracts
9. Customer search has no 2-char minimum gate (FR-005)
10. lucide-react@^1.16.0 looks like a typo

COSMETIC:
11. All 003 tasks in tasks.md still show [ ]; spec status still Draft
12. Dead vanilla dashboard/{app.js,api.js,styles.css} and dashboard/@/ mirror

See ~/dev/eurosport/SPEC_AUDIT.md for full detail.

title: Structured quantity field for orders
description: Add a dedicated quantity column to the orders table instead of parsing it from free-text specs. Benefits: easier sorting/filtering, structured reporting, input validation. Trade-off: more complex parsing for combined specs like '2x size M'.
